messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. Our orders with you for part:340010 rose from EUR 28.94 (po:4500010364-10) to EUR 29.89 (po:4500010407-10) between 2023-12-27 and 2024-01-05. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010), below your price. The forecast for part:340010 increased by 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Your letter says you prioritise firm, long-term commitments. The attached packages offer exactly that: a binding full annual volume over 24 or 36 months, which secures your capacity planning. What is the earliest lead time you can confirm on these terms?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We acknowledge your volume increase to 23400 units and your historical price references. For a 24-month contract with a 56-day lead time, we can offer a revised price of EUR 31.50 per unit. Shorter lead times require a premium and cannot be accommodated at this rate. 

Our Angebot is a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – revised packages for a firm 24/36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking our data into account. We have moved our prices a real step towards you in all three attached packages.

Each package commits the full 23400 pcs per year over 24 or 36 months. This gives you the firm, long-term commitment your letter of 18 September asks for and keeps your capacity planning predictable beyond our current contract.

We understand a shorter lead time ties up capacity. The 56-day package reflects your planning. The 42-day packages carry a step up to compensate for the faster schedule. Could you confirm which of the three you can sign? Is there a cheaper variant you would suggest?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – revised packages for a firm 24/36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

For a volume of 23400 pcs per year over a contract term of 24 months with a Lieferzeit of 56 days, we propose a price of €31.30 per unit. 

A 56-day lead time is the most cost-effective variant. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Application Engineering: We build to your drawing; we do not propose design changes.

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.
